pages.title: Trade Routes
pages.text: Plains greenhouses can contain tall crops. Desert greenhouses can contain peyote and a drying-table workstation. Search plains vineyard pieces for grapes and established lattices.

pages.title: Travel Chests
pages.text: Psychedelicraft adds supplies to several Overworld loot tables. Chests in abandoned mineshafts and dungeons can hold grapes, juniper berries, vessels and dried tobacco. Mineshafts can also hold smoking pipes.

pages.title: Village Chests
pages.text: Check shepherd, tannery, temple, toolsmith and weaponsmith chests for supplies. Temples can hold grapes. Toolsmith chests can hold joints, cups and filled syringes.

pages.title: Pack Rules
pages.text: Datapacks and the mod’s generation settings can change village structures and chest supplies. Chest loot is normally generated the first time it is opened. For exact sources in a pack, check its recipes and loot data.
